issues.failure_explanation: Property-(i) bounds the Rayleigh quotient of E''(φ_g)−λ_g I with respect to P_φ only on N_φM (the codimension-2 subspace of T_φM orthogonal to the symmetry directions). In the proof of Lemma C_t the projected iterate Proj^{P_φ_g}_φ_g d_n lies in T_φ_g M, which strictly contains N_φ_g M; the quadratic form ⟨(E''−λ_g)d_n,d_n⟩ is then bounded by L‖d_n‖²_{P_φ_g} using a supremum taken only over N_φ_g M. For a general (A6)-satisfying preconditioner the N_φ_g M–orthogonal complement T_φ_g S is not P_φ_g-orthogonal to N_φ_g M (e.g. for P=aI+H_φ one has H_φ iL_zφ_g ≠ λ_g iL_zφ_g), so the correct supremum L' on all of T_φ_g M can strictly exceed L. Consequently the energy-dissipation bound and the admissible step-size range (0,2/(L+ε)) use an incorrect constant.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Decompose T_φ_g M = N_φ_g M ⊕ T_φ_g S and use Prop1 (the quadratic form vanishes on T_φ_g S and cross terms vanish) to extend the Rayleigh quotient bound to all of T_φ_g M with a constant L' ≥ L obtained from norm equivalences and the P_φ_g-norm of the finite-dimensional complement. Then replace L by L' in Lemma C_t and the affected step-size ranges and rates. Alternatively, restrict the theorem to preconditioners satisfying the additional P_φ-orthogonality condition, under which L' = L and the original rate holds.
issues.overall_effect: The convergence-rate constant in Theorem Local-Convergence and the admissible step-size range become unreliable for preconditioners where the P_φ-orthogonal complement of N_φM in T_φM is not aligned with the symmetry directions (e.g. P=aI−(1/2)Δ, P=aI+H_0, P=aI+H_φ). The claimed rate √(1−(μ−ε)/(L+ε)) may replace L by a larger L', weakening the guarantee. Corollary E-eq-Phi inherits the affected constants through Theorem Local-Convergence. The refined optimal rate in Theorem Var-P-convergence (for the optimal preconditioner P=E''−(λ_g−σ_0)I, where the P-orthogonality does hold) is not affected.
issues.title: Rayleigh quotient bound from N_φM applied to T_φM in energy dissipation estimate
issues.why_classification: The qualitative conclusion (linear convergence to the minimizer orbit) is preserved with either fix. The repair needs a contained nontrivial argument (extending the spectral bound to T_φM or verifying P_φ-orthogonality for each preconditioner), but no new global proof architecture is required and the result remains recognizably the same modulo a weakened rate constant.

issues.failure_explanation: From (C_t1) one has ‖φ^{j+1}−φ^j‖_{H^1} ≤ C‖d_j‖_{H^1} ≤ C‖d_j‖_{P_{φ^j}}, which is first order in the gradient norm. The proof bounds the telescoping sum Σ‖φ^{j+1}−φ^j‖_{H^1} by CΣ‖d_j‖²_{P_{φ^j}} (squared P-norm), which is smaller than the correct bound for ‖d_j‖_{P_{φ^j}} < 1 and therefore does not follow from (C_t1). The subsequent estimate σ + CC_τσ_3 Σρ^j then understates the accumulation of the increments by one power of the gradient norm.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace ‖d_j‖²_{P_{φ^j}} by ‖d_j‖_{P_{φ^j}} in the telescoping sum bound and adjust the subsequent estimate to Σ‖d_j‖_{P_{φ^j}} ≤ √(C_τσ_3)/(1−√ρ), yielding ‖φ^{k+1}−φ̃_g‖_{H^1} ≤ σ + C√(C_τσ_3)/(1−√ρ). Choose σ and σ_3 so this is below σ_2; the induction then goes through unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The intermediate estimate ‖φ^{k+1}−φ̃_g‖_{H^1} ≤ σ + CC_τσ_3/(2(μ−ε)) is incorrect as derived; the correct bound involves √σ_3 rather than σ_3. However, the inductive argument still closes for σ_3 sufficiently small (since both bounds → 0), so the convergence rate and the formal statement of Theorem Local-Convergence are not changed. No downstream result becomes unreliable.
issues.title: Telescoping bound in Theorem Local-Convergence uses squared gradient norm where first power is required
issues.why_classification: The repair is a short, local correction (remove the exponent 2 and adjust one subsequent estimate from σ_3 to √σ_3). Every substantive claim and guarantee survives with no new lemma or replacement argument.
